title: The Patient Hymn
author: Elodie Hartwell
blurb: Beatrix Galloway, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
